create_TextGenerationDataset: create a TextGenerationDataset instance to load, preprocess, tokenize, and prepare a text dataset for fine-tuning
run_TextGenerationDataset_call: run the TextGenerationDataset __call__ method to load and process a dataset with preprocessing, tokenization, and label generation
load_dataset_from_path: load a dataset from Hugging Face or a local path using TextGenerationDataset.load_dataset with streaming and caching support
tokenize_dataset_with_processor: tokenize dataset rows using the model processor with padding, truncation, and prompt separation via TextGenerationDataset.tokenize
add_labels_with_prompt_masking: add labels to tokenized data and mask out prompt tokens and padding so they do not contribute to training loss
